column3: You walk like someone who's\nalready lost somebody.{end_wait}
Good. Then you know what\nI'm about to ask of you.{end_wait}
Saturos says you're just\nkids, but I'd like to see\nthat for myself.{end_wait}
Show me what Vale taught\nyou. Stand your ground.{end_wait}
There. That's the strength\nI was hoping to see.{end_wait}
Hold on to it. You're going\nto need all of it.{end_wait}
I didn't want to be the one\nto find out if you'd break.{end_wait}
Go on up. We'll be waiting\nat the top, by the stars.{end_wait}
And {protagonist_name}, when we meet\nagain, remember that I let\nyou pass.{end_wait}
That's enough, Menardi.\nYou've made your point.{end_wait}
They came here to stop us.\nThat makes them dangerous.{end_wait}
Come on. The stars are\nwaiting, and they can\nfollow us if they dare.{end_wait}
